HYPOTHESIS (natural language)

Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, the number of monuments (MonumentCount/ZMonument) and the frequency of axes–celts (AxesCelts/ZBeil) moved in the OPPOSITE direction to house size — the only dynamic element of symbolic capital. Monument building and axe/celt deposition did not track the stable prestige-object markers (hatchets–swords, daggers); instead, as large-house symbolism weakened (HouseSize Z falls steeply from +2.05 at 3400 BCE to around −0.06…+0.19 by 3100–3000 BCE, slope ≈ −0.46 Z per century), monument counts and axes/celts ROSE to a pronounced mid-window peak at 3200 BCE (MonumentCount +0.91, AxesCelts +2.60 — the latter an outlier) before falling back to near their starting levels by 3000 BCE. The aggregate symbolic-capital index (mean of ZAxtSchwert + ZDolch + Zhausgr) declines steadily across the window (slope ≈ −0.15 Z per century) and co-moves negatively with both monument counts (Pearson r = −0.35, Spearman ρ = −0.41) and axes–celts (r = −0.17, ρ = −0.37). This pattern is consistent with a shift in the focus of symbolic capital investment in the MN phase: away from competitive household display (shrinking house sizes) and toward communal monuments and standardized utilitarian/prestige tools (axes–celts), whose co-peak at 3200 BCE suggests a joint, short-lived intensification of collective-ritual and tool-deposition activity around that century, followed by partial decline. As context, the pollen-derived landscape-openness proxy for Belau/Woserin declines in step with the symbolic-capital index (r = +0.88 between the two), suggesting the household-display contraction coincided with a more closed/less-open landscape, though this co-movement is not claimed as causal.

Interpretation in one line: as symbolic capital embedded in houses waned through 3400–3000 BCE, communal monuments and axes/celts first surged (peaking 3200 BCE) and then partially receded — monument and axe counts vary inversely with the house-size component of symbolic capital over this half-millennium.

WORKFLOW (executed)

1. Loaded all three files and validated them (output log: outputs/analysis_output.txt):
   - time_series_data.csv: 3601 annual rows, CE −4100…−500; raw Z columns exist only at 37 hundred-year marks; *_inter columns complete; pollen raw sparse (177 points).
   - capital.csv: 39 rows, 100-year bins BCE 4300…500, no missing values; groups EN/MN/BA.
   - pollen_openness_score_…csv: 4084 rows, CE −4785…−702; raw Belau/Woserin PC1 sparse (206/156), interpolated/smoothed columns complete.
2. Sign-convention and alignment validation: capital.csv BCE values map exactly onto time_series_data.csv at CE = −BCE; all 12 Z-variable pairs match to 0.0 max absolute difference (37/39 rows; the two exceptions, BCE 4300/4200, lie outside the ts range). capital.csv is therefore the verified 100-year-binned master source.
3. Analysis window: 3400–3000 BCE, endpoints inclusive → exactly 5 bins (3400, 3300, 3200, 3100, 3000 BCE; all group MN).
4. Symbolic capital defined explicitly as the bin-wise mean of ZAxtSchwert (hatchets–swords), ZDolch (daggers) and Zhausgr (house size); CopperGold and Amber excluded per the study definition. Components also reported individually.
5. Outcomes: ZMonument (monument count) and ZBeil (axes–celts), each separately; ZMW (monument size) as secondary. Pollen openness = bin-wise mean of SMOOTH_MEAN_100y (interpolated/smoothed columns only, per instruction) from the pollen file.
6. Statistics (n = 5, descriptive only — no significance language): forward-in-time linear slopes per century; Pearson and Spearman correlations of the aggregate and each component vs each outcome, plus aggregate vs pollen openness and ZMonument vs ZBeil.
7. Cross-check: symbolic-capital mean and the two outcomes recomputed from time_series_data.csv raw 100-year points match capital.csv to 0.0 max difference.
8. Artifacts: executed script outputs/analysis_3400_3000BCE.py; binned table outputs/window_bins_3400_3000BCE.csv; full log outputs/analysis_output.txt.

KEY NUMBERS (window bins)

BCE | HatchetSword | Dagger | HouseSize | SymCap(mean) | MonumentCount | AxesCelts | PollenOpen.
3400 | −0.43 | −0.58 | +2.05 | +0.347 | −0.465 | 0.37 | +0.27
3300 | −0.43 | −0.58 | +0.79 | −0.073 | −0.133 | 0.32 | −0.09
3200 | −0.43 | −0.58 | +0.79 | −0.073 | +0.913 | 2.60 | −0.51
3100 | −0.42 | −0.58 | −0.06 | −0.353 | +0.352 | 0.80 | −1.57
3000 | −0.43 | −0.58 | +0.19 | −0.273 | −0.363 | 0.80 | −1.81

Correlations (n=5): SymCap vs MonumentCount r=−0.35/ρ=−0.41; SymCap vs AxesCelts r=−0.17/ρ=−0.37; HouseSize alone gives nearly identical values (−0.35/−0.41 and −0.17/−0.37); MonumentCount vs AxesCelts r=+0.87/ρ=+0.62; SymCap vs PollenOpenness r=+0.88/ρ=+0.87.

CAVEATS STATED IN THE HYPOTHESIS

- Dagger is exactly constant (−0.58) and hatchets–swords near-constant (−0.43…−0.42) in the window (correlations undefined/weak); the symbolic-capital signal is carried almost entirely by the house-size component — this is stated explicitly.
- The 3200 BCE axes value (Z=2.60) is an outlier; both Pearson and Spearman are reported and all claims are framed descriptively.
- Pollen co-movement is context only, not a causal claim; pollen openness used only from interpolated/smoothed columns.
- Only 5 independent bins; trends are directional descriptions, not statistically tested effects.

payload.hypothesis: Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, monument counts and axes–celts moved opposite to the only dynamic element of symbolic capital, house size: as large-house display weakened (HouseSize Z falls from +2.05 at 3400 BCE to ≈0 by 3100–3000 BCE), monument counts and axes–celts rose to a pronounced joint peak at 3200 BCE (Z +0.91 and +2.60) before partially receding by 3000 BCE. The aggregate symbolic-capital index (mean of hatchets–swords, daggers, house size) declines steadily (≈ −0.15 Z/century) and co-moves negatively with monument counts (Pearson r = −0.35, Spearman ρ = −0.41) and axes–celts (r = −0.17, ρ = −0.37), consistent with a shift of symbolic investment from competitive household display toward communal monuments and standardized tools. Daggers are exactly constant and hatchets–swords near-constant in the window, so the inverse signal is carried almost entirely by house size. Landscape openness from pollen (Belau/Woserin) declines in step with the symbolic-capital index (r = +0.88) — context only, not a causal claim.
